answer: Replica herds fail a dye trace they cannot split. An applicant posts 3.95 POA and draws one swallow-hole among 18 karst shafts in separate basins. At local solar zenith they lower a 2.4 kg anchor canister, release 38 ml of 15-bit dye bound to their pubkey and the epoch seed, and a spring 420 m downslope logs the pulse in seconds 50-95. 140 clones would pin 553 POA and need 140 exclusive shafts. Graders replay the shaft draw from the seed, match the spectrograph bits, and weigh the empty canister to 5 g. A reused shaft, missed pulse, or bit clash slashes 55% and seals that hole for 4 epochs.
